# Vej

> Vej is the company building Pea (2B), Pepper (8B) and Pumpkin (27B). Pea is the current text model, available through limited hosted early access or as Pea 1 weights at https://huggingface.co/ItsVej/pea-1 after an approved Hugging Face access request, that returns native probabilities over developer-supplied outcomes. It provides native distributions without text generation, JSON parsing, or answer-token scoring. Apache-2.0 code and adaptations, completed model, text only.

Last updated: 2026-10-18.

## Model family
- Pea (green): Current 2B text completed model. Limited hosted early access. Pea 1 weights are listed at https://huggingface.co/ItsVej/pea-1 and require an approved Hugging Face access request. All published results describe Pea.
- Pepper (red): 8B model in development, being built and tested privately with companies. No public release or published benchmarks.
- Pumpkin (orange): 27B model under research and development, being tested privately with companies. No public release or published benchmarks.

Contact: [hello@itsvej.com](mailto:hello@itsvej.com). Hosted API access is by request. Pea 1 weights require an approved Hugging Face access request. Sign in to the [console](https://app.itsvej.com/) with an API key.

## Key Facts
- Three primitives: Choice (pick among named options), Noul (assess statement truth as true/false), Score (rate rubric levels with expectation computed in caller code).
- Test performance: 76.60% exact accuracy overall across 14,286 frozen test decisions (Choice 89.22%, Noul 91.71%, Score 51.62%).
- Paper (2026-10-13): "Native Candidate Probabilities from a 2B Decoder on a Single Consumer GPU". Pre-registered comparison on the same 14,286 decisions: Pea 76.60% accuracy, NLL 0.589; prompted open 2B/4B instruct models in the comparison at most 55.66% accuracy and at best NLL 1.134; the 9B model in FP8 (descriptive) 62.30%, NLL 1.003. Pea is not the fastest: 9.38 decisions/s with prefix caching versus 20.88 for letter-mode prompting of the open 2B model on one RX 9070 XT. PDF: https://itsvej.com/paper/vej-native-candidate-probabilities.pdf
- Hosted Jev comparison: Hosted Jev 1.13 scored 71.76% overall on the same test rows with documented rounding adjustment. Jev returned 99.31% strict format validity. This is not a claim of general superiority.
- Availability: The hosted API is live in limited early access at https://api.itsvej.com (Pea only, text only; image input is refused). Capacity is limited, with no uptime guarantee yet. Pea 1 weights are listed at https://huggingface.co/ItsVej/pea-1. Downloads require an approved Hugging Face access request. The repository root is the serving export and checkpoint/ is the native checkpoint. Core development repository is private.
- Licensing: Vej code and model adaptations are Apache-2.0. The upstream base model and original datasets retain their respective terms.

- Hosted interfaces: GA `/v1/predict` for Choice, Noul and Score, `/v1/systemone` for Jev, and Cloudflare-compatible formats are live. Hosted use requires an API key, not checkpoint access.
- Local interfaces: `vej predict` CLI; `vej serve --backend local` with `/v1/predict`, `/v1/systemone` for the TypeSafe Python SDK, and the Cloudflare Clef Workers AI route. Local inference requires the Pea 1 weights and the private Vej source. Serving, SDK adapters, export and the context override require current private Vej source.
- Context: 2,048 tokens per rendered candidate by default; native Pea accepts `--max-length 49152`. Long-context quality is not validated.
- Modality: The released Pea checkpoint is designed and evaluated for text decisions.
- Research: Noul improvement work paused on 2026-10-09 without promoting a new model; Pea and its published evaluation are unchanged.

## Changes since September
- 2026-10-13 paper: published the Pea paper and its supplement; the evaluation page adds the open-model comparison.
- 2026-10-10 site update: documents local HTTP, Jev/Clef SDK compatibility, the experimental private Pea classification export, and the context override.
- 2026-10-09 research pause: no new checkpoint promoted.
- 2026-10-18 hosted status: limited early access is live, by request, using Pea’s native reference runtime. States are hosted Beta with organization retention opt-in and encrypted history storage. Batch is not open yet. Pea 1 weights are listed at https://huggingface.co/ItsVej/pea-1 and require an approved Hugging Face access request.

## Forms
- Access requests, model waitlists and newsletter signups are stored in a separate Cloudflare D1 database in the EU. Access is reviewed; a saved request does not grant model access.
- Actual enquiries: hello@itsvej.com.

## Usage guidance
- Evaluation detail: Score exact accuracy is 51.62%; tool development diagnostics passed 30 of 48 harder cases. See the full evaluation for scope and methodology.
- No calibrated risk: Descriptive probabilities are not guarantees of correctness or authorisation to execute tools.
- No speed claim: Inference uses repeated state encoding; AMD development measurements exist; no production latency, capacity or speed advantage is claimed.
- Hosted Beta: `/v1beta` risk targets with calibrations, alignments, estimate, annotate, feedback, given, bind, flows, effort and rankings are live. Effort executes standard only; fast and careful are not available. Beta availability does not establish quality or promotion to `/v1`.
- Rankings: Beta is live, but the quality gate failed on the sealed final evaluation for both seeds; the endpoint contract also failed. `/v1/rankings` is not promoted.
- States: `/v1beta/states` is live as Beta. An organization administrator must opt in via `PUT /v1beta/retention/states` with `{"enabled":true}`. Vej stores history encrypted in temporary local-directory Beta storage. Sessions expire after 24 hours idle or 30 days from creation, whichever comes first; activity never extends the absolute deadline. Revocation denies access and schedules physical erasure. History is capped at 100,000 code points and full history is re-read for predictions; no cache saving is claimed.
- Batch: Routes exist, but running jobs requires approved EU storage hosts, which are not configured yet. Batch is not open.

- [Website privacy](https://itsvej.com/privacy/): Signup data, purpose and removal requests.
- [Newsletter](https://itsvej.com/access/#newsletter): Vej updates by email.

Hosted Pea currently runs the native reference runtime. Hosted Choice, Noul and Score probabilities use temperature 1.334, fitted on 2,026 held-out calibration decisions and checked on 1,016 further decisions. That scale does not make a stated probability a guaranteed frequency on a new workflow. Published native evaluations remain temperature-1 checkpoint results, not a separate hosted evaluation. Estimate responses still report calibration_status "uncalibrated".

If hosted Pea moves to vLLM, probabilities may differ from the native reference by up to about 0.05 (five percentage points) in development checks. Served-runtime temperature fitting and separate held-out verification would be needed. This development tolerance is not a claim of native equivalence or a universal error bound.

Hosted API responses currently identify the model only as pea. Pepper and Pumpkin are not served. Native and compatibility results use a public model string; Cloudflare wraps it in result. Realtime metadata permits only modality and calibration_status. Beta metadata may additionally contain opaque SHA-256 compatibility bindings and documented ranking part bindings. Batch result bodies follow the same contract. Internal diagnostics are not part of the hosted response contract.
